correction.scientific_rationale: The final v3 architecture and checkpoint selector must not use the structural distribution of the component-family heldout fold. The v2 policy named all 112,386 source rows as the selection reference. Earlier held-component outputs remain preserved as explicitly nonselecting diagnostics, so the fold is not described as globally untouched and later fold-level results remain descriptive rather than a pristine final test.
correction.additional_evaluator_fix: Normalize only the path and sha256 fields of the metadata-bearing product-reference specification, then filter the hash-verified 112,386-row source file to the preregistered train and calibration folds before exact-reproduction and descriptor calculations.

unconditional_program_prior.source: new independent draw from the unchanged training-fold, source- and family-balanced program prior

frozen_product_reference.heldout_use: excluded from the final v3 selector; earlier exploratory outputs are preserved as nonselecting diagnostics and later fold-level results are descriptive

descriptor_distribution_realism_floors.reference_population: 82,264 selection-visible Ugi products from the train and calibration folds; the 30,122 component-family heldout products are excluded from the final v3 selector
